title: INTRUSION INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Intrusion Inc., a small-cap technology company listed on NASDAQ Capital Market, entered into a Note Purchase Agreement on April 6, 2026, issuing a $3,230,000 Secured Promissory Note to Streeterville Capital, LLC for cash proceeds of $3,000,000. The note carries a 7% annual interest rate, matures in 24 months, and is secured by the company's assets and intellectual property.
key_points: Intrusion Inc. issued a $3,230,000 Secured Promissory Note to Streeterville Capital, LLC on April 6, 2026
Cash proceeds were $3,000,000 reflecting a $210,000 original issue discount plus $20,000 in transaction expenses
Note bears interest at 7% per annum, compounded daily, with a 24-month maturity
Note is secured by a first-priority security interest in all company assets and intellectual property
Purchase Agreement includes a 10% participation right for the investor in future debt or equity financings
The company is listed on NASDAQ Capital Market under ticker symbol INTZ
